text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Arab industry officials meet in Riyadh on Tuesday to discuss protection of domestic products and boosting foreign investments.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange trade volume falls on Monday in price correction.
- Finance minister forms committee to manage the portfolio of the Public Institution for Social Security.

- Audit bureau says performance of firms in which the state has a stake shows improvement. The bureau, a state watchdog, monitors the performance of firms with a state holdings of more than 25 percent.
- British businessman sentenced by a Kuwaiti court to five years in jail on charges of forgery, man to appeal against ruling.
